column3: Oh really? I toooooooooooootally get it now.
Kirino started fiddling with her phone out of my sight and began to call someone.
At that moment, I was filled with foreboding, but by then, it was already too late.
That idiot next door, he... he...! Ahhhhhhh!
Kirino, hey! What do you think you're...
No, don't show me those strange books from under your bed! Nooooooo!
...This is less punishment than you deserve. You should thank me.
It's not like I don't know what situation I'm in.
As I fell to my knees in defeat, Kirino lorded over me with a victorious grin.
